// SYNTAX TEST "source.dsm"

function fib(v0: int64): int64 {
// <- keyword.declaration.function.dsm
//       ^^^ entity.name.function.dsm
//           ^^ variable.other.ssa.dsm
//               ^^^^^ support.type.dsm
//                       ^^^^^ support.type.dsm

bb0(v0: int64):
// <- entity.name.label.dsm
//  ^^ variable.other.ssa.dsm
//      ^^^^^ support.type.dsm

    v1: int64 = const 2int64
//  ^^ variable.other.ssa.dsm
//      ^^^^^ support.type.dsm
//              ^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm
//                    ^^^^^^ constant.numeric.dsm

    v2: boolean = int.lt.s v0, v1
//  ^^ variable.other.ssa.dsm
//      ^^^^^^^ support.type.dsm
//                ^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm

    branch v2, bb1, bb2
//  ^^^^^^ keyword.control.flow.dsm
//             ^^^ entity.name.label.dsm
//                  ^^^ entity.name.label.dsm

    store v0, v1
//  ^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm

    local.set v0, v1
//  ^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm

    v6: slice<(int64, int64) -> int64> = new.slice.zeroed (int64, int64) -> int64, v5
//      ^^^ support.type.dsm
//                                       ^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm

    v7: int64 = const -1int64
//                    ^^^^^^^ constant.numeric.dsm

    local local0: ref<int64, copy>
//  ^^^^^ keyword.declaration.dsm
//        ^^^^^^ variable.other.local.dsm
//                           ^^^^ keyword.other.memory.dsm

    v8: ref<int64, copy> = local.get local0
//  ^^ variable.other.ssa.dsm
//                         ^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm
//                                   ^^^^^^ variable.other.local.dsm

    function.address function0
//  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm
//                   ^^^^^^^^^ entity.name.function.dsm

    call print(v0)
//  ^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm

    intrinsic.memset(v0, v1)
//  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm

// comment
// <- comment.line.double-slash.dsm
}

external function @host.print(v0: ref<borrowed vector<int32, 4>>) -> void
// <- keyword.declaration.dsm
//                                ^^^ support.type.dsm
//                                    ^^^^^^^^ keyword.other.memory.dsm
//                                             ^^^^^^ support.type.dsm

function @refs(v0: ref<int32, managed, nullable>) -> typeDescriptor {
//                 ^^^ support.type.dsm

}

function @unique(v0: ref<int32, unique, readonly>) -> void {

}

function @raw(v0: ref<int32, raw, space(shared)>) -> void {

}

function @borrow(v0: ref<int32, borrowed, lifetime(0)>) -> void {

}

type @AtomicCounter = atomic<uint32>;
//                    ^^^^^^ support.type.dsm
//                           ^^^^^^ support.type.dsm

type @Outcome = variant<uint8> {
//              ^^^^^^^ support.type.dsm
//                      ^^^^^ support.type.dsm
    0uint8 = int32;
//  ^^^^^^ constant.numeric.dsm
}

export global @COUNTER: ref<raw const int64>
// <- keyword.declaration.dsm
//            ^^^^^^^^ entity.name.symbol.dsm
//                          ^^^ keyword.other.memory.dsm
//                              ^^^^^ keyword.other.memory.dsm

function @tokens(v0: ref<int64, raw>, v1: ref<dynamic<@Iface>, owned>) -> void {
entry0(v0: ref<int64, raw>):
    jump block1
//  ^^^^ keyword.control.flow.dsm
block1:
    switch v0, block2, block3
//  ^^^^^^ keyword.control.flow.dsm
block2:
    tailCall.virtual @Klass.method(v0) -> (int64) -> void
//  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm
    call.dynamic @Iface.method(v0) -> (int64) -> void
//  ^^^^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm
    call.indirect v0(v1) -> (int64) -> void
//  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm
    v2: boolean = select true, false, true
//                ^^^^^^ keyword.operator.instruction.dsm
//                       ^^^^ constant.language.boolean.dsm
//                             ^^^^^ constant.language.boolean.dsm
    call @log("line\\nvalue", 'x')
//       ^^^^ entity.name.symbol.dsm
//            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ string.quoted.double.dsm
//                            ^^^ constant.character.quoted.single.dsm
block3:
    panic
//  ^^^^^ keyword.control.flow.dsm
    panic.resume
//  ^^^^^^^^^^^^ keyword.control.flow.dsm
    trap.abort
//  ^^^^^^^^^^ keyword.control.flow.dsm
    unreachable
//  ^^^^^^^^^^^ keyword.control.flow.dsm
}
